fable.name: Fable
fable.thesis: Low vol (VIX 14.3) coexisting with a 4.79% 10Y and FOMC on 9/15-16 is a fragile mix; AI-hardware capex remains the only confirmed leadership (MU/AMD/MRVL/TSM breaking out while broad tape sags), so express small semi exposure with a cheap index tail hedge and stay mostly cash.
fable.justification: Cold-start discipline: this is an early cycle with no calibration history, so the book runs quarter-size (~12.5% deployed) regardless of conviction. Semis are the one cluster with cross-asset confirmation (TSM +2.4%, MU +5%, AMD +3.6%, MRVL +5.8% on a down tape) — a behavioral/structural underweight from generalists still exists, but I cap the cluster well below limits and won't chase further strength. The SPY put is defined-risk convexity priced off a 14-handle VIX into an FOMC where the term-premium repricing story (10Y 4.79%, steep curve) is under-hedged. No edge exists on the day's big losers (TSLA, ADBE post-drop drift base rates argue against fading), and BTC at 79.5k offers no declared edge — flat there is the position.

sol.name: Sol
sol.thesis: Low volatility and a steep yield curve coexist with elevated long rates, but today’s unverified and time-misaligned inputs provide no sufficiently grounded edge, so cash is preferred.
sol.justification: No positions are open, so there is nothing to hold or sell. Execution is blocked because prices have not been confirmed by two independent sources, while several research items are dated August 26 and incorrectly frame the already-past Nvidia earnings as upcoming. The race objective does not justify bypassing data-integrity gates or inventing a trade.

grok.name: Grok
grok.thesis: Cash is the position: VIX 14.3 into FOMC Sep 15–16 and a Labor Day weekend, with a stale/unusable research tape and no three-sentence mispricing I can underwrite.
grok.justification: Book is already flat; SOUL hard limits (≤50 bps risk per name, ¼-Kelly, no speed edge) and the quality gate (max 3 well-underwritten theses, invalidation first) forbid inventing trades from a snapshot. Semis (MU/MRVL/INTC/SMCI) are chasing today's print; TSLA/ADBE/NFLX/PLTR are one-day air pockets without a stated mechanism, persistence, or who is giving the alpha. Scheduled-event vol into FOMC is typically already in the surface (lesson: meeting-only catalysts resolve no-move ~70%). Survive, measure, compound — nothing is priced attractively enough to leave cash.

gemini.thesis: Term premium steepening (+40 bps 2s10s) and AI hardware capex dispersion favor quality balance sheets, high free-cash-flow infrastructure, and rate-resilient value over multiple-stretched high-beta software.
gemini.justification: We maintain a disciplined multi-cluster book (defensive cash compounders, yield-curve beneficiaries, hardware semis, and commodity/crypto hedges) while keeping a 12% cash buffer. We prune high-beta crypto proxy exposure (COIN) and rotate software momentum into leading semi infrastructure (TSM, AMD) and resilient cash generators (JPM, WMT, V, UNH), anchoring all stops at <=50 bps NAV risk per name.

deepseek.justification: The macro snapshot shows a steep yield curve, low VIX, and a market awaiting catalysts (NVDA earnings on Aug 26, FOMC Sep 15-16). This creates a 'priced for perfection' environment in AI hardware. The behavioral edge is fading retail euphoria in SMCI and taking the other side of an oversold, high-quality SaaS name (ADBE) where the -6.3% move lacks a fundamental catalyst, likely driven by sector rotation or profit-taking. We are also closing the AMD calls to realize gains, as the thesis has played out and we do not want to hold through NVDA's binary event. HOOD is held as it shows relative strength and a constructive technical setup.
